lines.en: A bit dramatic with that whole 'end of the world' speech, don't ya think?
lines.zh: 那整一个“末日将至”的演讲有点耸人听闻了，你不觉得吗？
lines.name: 斯泰凡

lines.en: ...Protagonist is not familiar with the Temple's ways.  It may be just what he/she needed to hear.
lines.zh: ……Protagonist不太熟悉圣殿的做事方式。 这可能正是he/she需要听到的。
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: ...You're really serious about this stuff, aren't you?
lines.name: 斯泰凡

lines.en: Just as the cult was deliberate in finding the Nephilim, so too must the Paladins be when countering their actions.
lines.zh: 正如邪教有意寻找圣灵一样，圣骑士也必须针对性地进行反击。
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: Must be easy to think everything and anything happens for a reason...  As though the fate of all reality is set in stone, so why bother setting out to change it?
lines.zh: 相信“凡事有因”的人肯定很轻松…… 不论过程怎样，一切都会顺着因果之线导向注定的结局。那还努力改变什么呢？
lines.name: 斯泰凡

lines.en: ...There are some things I would change, Stefan.  The life of a warrior is difficult.  The comforts of home call out to me...
lines.zh: ……我会改变一些事的，斯泰凡。 战士的生活很艰难。 舒适的家在呼唤着我……
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: Little Alex?  Yeah, bet the kid really misses you...
lines.zh: 小艾利克斯？ 是的，我打赌这孩子一定很想你……
lines.name: 斯泰凡

lines.en: Yes...  But my son deserves a better world to inherit.  If Zanatus is returning to our world, I must remain out here, fighting against fate, inevitable as though it may be.
lines.zh: 没错…… 但我的儿子值得生活在一个更美好的世界。 如果扎纳图斯要重返我们的世界，我就必须留在这里，与宿命搏斗，哪怕无法将其改变。
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: Yeah... I hear ya.  He's a good kid.  Wish I had somethin' as precious as Alex is to you.
lines.zh: 是啊……我懂你。 他是个好孩子。 真希望我也有什么被我珍视之物，就像艾利克斯对于你而言。
lines.name: 斯泰凡

lines.en: ...My Alex worships you.  You're practically his own father.
lines.zh: ……我的艾利克斯很崇拜你。 你就像他的父亲一样。
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: Can you play that tune he likes so much? I have grown very fond of it as well...
lines.zh: 你能弹弹那首他非常喜欢的曲子吗？那曲子我现在也非常喜欢……
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: Just gonna make you miss home even more...
lines.zh: 不过那首歌只会让你更想家……
lines.name: 斯泰凡
